text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
I look forward to your continued support this year.
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.text:
Though they had already exchanged greetings through New Year's cards,
seeing each other in person felt special. Fired up, they prepared for the Classic year about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much... not only for the New Year's card, but for the New Year's gift as well.
choice_data_list: No, no, it's really nothing much.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. My mother was overjoyed with it, too.
The dashi broth set, that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I tried using it in the ozoni right away...
and it had a wonderfully refined flavor.
I was a little worried it might still be too plain, as usual... but it seems there was no need to fret.
choice_data_list: Looks like you had a relaxing New Year's holiday.

text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah seems quite refreshed.
Wondering how else she spent her time,
I asked her about it, and—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Other than that... oh, I spent time with Shakur-san.
Air Shakur... She's a Double Crown Umamusume who's my senior both in school year and generation, and she's well known across campus for being exceptionally sharp, but—

Her clever, cool demeanor
and the image of 'spending a relaxing New Year's'...
just don't seem to match up at all.
choice_data_list: W-What kind of New Year is that...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Um, first Shakur-san came all the way to my house to give New Year's greetings...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh, have I ever mentioned this before?
Shakur-san has been looking out for me
ever since I was very little.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Childhood friend" might be an exaggeration, but we used to see each other occasionally even before enrolling here.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Shakur-san's mother is a wonderful singer.
She used to be a bar singer in the past, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: And so, my mother became a fan of that song—
choice_data_list: So our daughters have become friends as well, huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. Shakur-san has always been so brilliant... Everything he says is fascinating, so I couldn't help but draw near.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
They often scowled and glared at me, but...
fufu, I was still grateful that they didn't chase me away.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: So even now... though it's usually just around New Year's, Shakur-san still comes over to visit my family's place sometimes—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...'Sup.
HAPPY. NEW. YEAR.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Shakur-san.
Happy New Year!
Thank you so much for coming!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Mother, Shakur gave this to me.
She said it is a New Year's greeting gift.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Thank you for going out of your way.
Fufu, I'd love to meet Shakur's mother again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It was cold outside, wasn't it? I'll brew something warm,
so please, take a seat.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm good. My mom told me to...
I just came to drop this off.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: See ya.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, already? Um... oh, Messiah.
I'll wrap up the coffee gift quickly, so
please give it to Shakur-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
A return gift for the New Year's present, you see.
Just wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I told you I don't need it.
You're way too meticulous, y'know that?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Since you went out of your way to come here so early in the New Year, please accept this small token of gratitude from my mother and me.

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Misteeer, over here, over here!
It's super lively around the shrine!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry and go on our New Year's shrine visit~!!
Ehehe, let's draw fortune slips together too~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, Shakur-san. Do you... have any plans
yet for after this?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, why an internet cafe?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, no... I just thought you might want to work on your PC, Shakur-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...So Miss Serious isn't doing
Hatsumode or anything, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I thought about that too,
but I figured they'd probably turn me down...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Besides, I have already offered my New Year's greetings before the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ha. So you're just a goody two-shoes in the end.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Wait. That.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Manga.
You still read 'em?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've always loved shonen manga.
This series in particular has such powerful dialogue.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! Oh, LANE...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That author posted something like a side story on Umatter, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank you very much!
I'll take a look later...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
And so on and so forth, we ended up spending
a whole day together at the net cafe...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you,
I was able to spend a very meaningful New Year's holiday.
choice_data_list: Manga really does give you strength, doesn't it?
I wonder if we got to relax like we did when we were little?
I wonder what else you talked about with Air Shakur...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, truly. I do enjoy reading classic shonen manga, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm always inspired by
the passionate dedication of the characters.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To maintain an unbroken spirit even in the face of hardship.
To strive single-mindedly toward your dream.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Putting it into words might make it sound cliché...
Yet, it reminds us once again of the things
we truly need to engrave upon our hearts."
choice_data_list: That's a wonderful way to approach it...!
That's a wonderful way to approach it, isn't it...!

text_block_list.text:
Since I had the chance, I asked Air Messiah in detail
about the series she was currently obsessed with.

I buy the e-book as well and check it from the cover.
It seems to be a space adventure story, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My favorite character
is the one on the cover of Volume 4.
choice_data_list: Did she teach you a lot of things?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, no, she's...
Well, she's pretty much a villain, so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Still... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It is cool. The special move, that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. To relax for the first time in a while
with family... and with Shakur-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, though as I mentioned at first,
even when we were little, it's not like
we spent all that much time together.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Still, they do exist within my memories.
Memories like grains of sand, without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Shakur's mother, singing in a beautiful dress
at a bar filled with a mature atmosphere.
And my own mother, quietly taking it in...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur-san was always sitting
way in the corner.
To the point it was sometimes hard to spot her."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"She only started bringing in a PC
after she grew up a bit... Before then,
she'd be poring over really complex-looking books."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I believe it was a math book.
...Fufu, I couldn't make any sense of it at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
So, I just watched.
In the dim candlelight of the desk lamp.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I've always been rather fond of studying.
However, I've come to think—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Sometimes I look back and wonder if my yearning for wisdom... began all the way back then.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Others, you say? Well, let me see...
Since they are rather taciturn—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, Shakur-san, even so,
I feel like you've become much more talkative."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I believe it started after she entered Tracen Academy.
Even before I enrolled, every now and then... little by little,
she would tell me about her school friends.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I thought for sure she would be surrounded
by many classmates, like Doto-senpai, Tachyon-senpai,
Tap-senpai, and Fine-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: We were just talking about that exact topic the other day, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Fufu. ...Before I knew it, I was the one doing all the talking about Craft-san, Cesario-san, and Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Looking back on it now... she might have
expertly drawn the words out of me.
choice_data_list: I guess they were wondering if you had any friends.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Do I... look like I don't have any? Friends, I mean...
choice_data_list: Ah, not in a weird way!

text_block_list.text:
It's natural to worry whether someone
you've known since childhood is enjoying academy life.

Could that have been Air Shakur's intention too?
I decided to ask.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I wonder... how that will turn out.
Fufu, it seems quite difficult to fathom.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: If so, I hope the message 'There is no problem at all' was properly conveyed.
